author: 5kO0
content:
Implemented (this session). Two pieces in proto-blue-codegen/src/generator.rs.

1) Expanded sanitize_ident keyword list:
   Added Edition 2024 hard keywords (gen, try) and reserved-for-future (abstract, become, box, do, final, macro, override, priv, typeof, unsized, virtual, yield), plus the weak/contextual `union` and `dyn` defensively. Reorganised the match arm by edition era (2015-2021 strict / 2018-promoted / 2024-promoted / reserved-for-future / weak) so future updates know where to slot new keywords.

2) Added disambiguate(seen: &mut HashSet<String>, candidate) -> String helper and wired it into the four field/variant emission sites:
   - generate_object (struct fields, with `r#type` pre-seeded for record types)
   - generate_params (XRPC param fields)
   - generate_string_enum (enum variants)
   - generate_union (union variants, with `Other` pre-seeded for open unions)

Design choice (audit asked which to pick): auto-disambiguate with `_2`, `_3`, ... suffix + a doc comment noting the collision, rather than erroring at generation time. Reasoning: codegen runs against third-party schemas the SDK doesn't control; erroring means a single weird lexicon out there breaks the whole run. The suffix approach keeps generated code valid Rust, the collision stays visible in the source, and serde renames preserve the wire form. Strict mode can be added later as a flag if anyone wants it.

Tests added (5 new):
   - test_sanitize_ident_edition_2024_and_reserved — every new keyword escapes to r#-form, plain identifiers pass through
   - test_disambiguate_returns_candidate_when_unique
   - test_disambiguate_appends_suffix_on_collision (incl. cascading collisions like foo, foo_2, foo, foo_2_2)
   - collision_in_object_produces_disambiguated_fields — synthetic LexObject with myField + my_field properties; asserts both emit as distinct Rust fields, the disambiguated one carries serde(rename) to its wire form, and the doc comment is present
   - edition_2024_keyword_field_emits_raw_ident — synthetic LexObject with `gen` field; asserts pub r#gen: ...

Verification (rust-quality §honest reporting):
   cargo test -p proto-blue-codegen           PASS (16 tests; 5 new + 11 existing)
   cargo build --workspace                    PASS
   cargo test --workspace                     PASS (0 failures)
   cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings   PASS
   cargo fmt --all --check                    PASS

Behavioural change:
   - For real-world workspace lexicons: zero change — none of the 322 lexicons today contain colliding sibling fields/variants or use a 2024-reserved word as a field name, so regenerated output matches the post-#3 state byte-for-byte.
   - For future or third-party lexicons: keywords previously not escaped (gen, try, etc.) now emit as r#-prefixed identifiers; collisions emit as disambiguated `name_2` etc. with serde(rename) preserving wire form.

Category: A (root-cause) — added the missing sanitize_ident coverage and the missing collision-detection invariant across all field/variant emission paths in one bump.
